_note: Official Terraria track (tModLoader 1.4.4). No agent has been scored here yet: every entry, curve and heatmap cell is sample data. The contract is a draft. Speed numbers are real (experiments/tml-speed-20261107).

contract.game: Terraria 1.4.4.9 via tModLoader v2026.08.3.0, small world (4200x1200), Classic difficulty, fixed public and hidden world seeds
contract.harness: Every model runs in the same harness: one prompt, the same observation, the same action interface, the same budgets. No native coding-agent harnesses, no direct tile edits.
contract.observation: Screenshot plus a symbolic state block exported by the mod (nearby tiles, inventory, health, time, position). RL policies get exactly the same observation.
contract.actions: Keyboard and pointer input at 4 game ticks per action (15 actions per in-game second at 60 ticks/s).
contract.scoring: Milestones read from the mod's checkpoint log; earliest step of each milestone is recorded. Weighted like Terraria-Lite v9 tiers. No self-reported progress.
contract.validity: Runs with direct tile control or harness errors are listed as invalid with the reason, as TerrariaBench does.

entries.cost_note: training compute; per-episode inference is under $0.01

entries.sub: maximally good RL, warm start from Terraria-Lite policy

first_unlock_minutes._note: Game minutes at which each milestone was first reached (median over worlds); null = never. Sample data.

rl_cost_model._note: What training PPO on real Terraria would cost, from our measured tModLoader speed (upper bound on speed: client-side player logic and observation extraction not included) and the placeholder CPU rate in costs.json.
rl_cost_model.source: experiments/tml-speed-20261107/README.md (about 880 actions/s per core at 4 processes)
